description:
The 'Winter Sale' is approaching, and as the visual merchandiser, you need to prioritize specific high-value items in the shop catalog. 

Goal: Modify the 'Menu order' for two products so they appear at the top of the default sorting list:
1. 'Merino Wool Sweater' must be the very first item (Position 1).
2. 'Slim Fit Denim Jeans' must be the second item (Position 2).

Navigate to the Products list in the WooCommerce admin. You can use 'Quick Edit' or the 'Advanced' tab inside the product edit screen to change the 'Menu order' value. Remember that in WooCommerce, lower numbers (including negative numbers) appear first. The default value is usually 0.
